hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; [ -L "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.py|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml|*.sh) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; rel="${f#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}"; case "$rel" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._/-]*) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$rel" in *..*) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && LINT_FILE="$rel" make -s lint-file >&2 || exit 2

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "Subagent finished. NEXT STEP: Call TaskList to see the task list, mark this task done with TaskUpdate, then immediately dispatch the next pending task to a new subagent. Do not stop until all tasks are complete."}}'

input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; json.load(sys.stdin)' >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; c=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n\\' '  '); gh='(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_-])gh[[:space:]]([^;&|]*[[:space:]])?'; if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq "${gh}pr[[:space:]]+(create|new|ready)([^A-Za-z0-9_-]|\$)"; then :; elif printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq "${gh}api[[:space:]]" && printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq "pulls([[:space:]\"'?]|\$)" && printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eiq "(-X|--method)[[:space:]=]*POST|[[:space:]](-f|-F|--field|--raw-field|--input)([[:space:]=]|\$)"; then :; else exit 0; fi; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; sha=$(git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD); f="$(git rev-parse --git-dir)/pre-pr-review"; saved=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$sha" ] && [ "$saved" = "$sha" ] && exit 0; echo 'Pre-PR review required for HEAD '"${sha:-<no commits>}"': run the /pre-pr-review skill (code-review, ponytail:ponytail-review, simplify, security-review on the branch diff), fix or answer findings, commit, then retry.' >&2; exit 2
if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then git status --short; git diff --stat; fi
